_comment: Runnable example of the encoded candidate stage config read by scripts/lab/candidate-build.sh.
The builder takes every build input from this file and never from an operator environment
variable; it resolves the block at apptheory.candidate (preferred) or deployment.apptheory.candidate
(the Autheory app-theory/stages/*.json shape). The config declares the surface subset that is
built, verified, handed over and receipted (at least one surface); this example declares all seven,
and each sha256 is verified against a fresh build of the pinned commit, so a mismatch fails closed.
An undeclared surface is never built. The exact hashes and
commit/tree below are placeholders -- a real candidate is admitted only by a witnessed build that
records the observed values here. See CANDIDATE_BUILD_INTERFACE.md (section 4) for the trust chain.
Values are placeholders of the correct shape only: 40 lowercase hex for commit/tree, 64 hex for
sha256, and an npm-shaped sha512 integrity. This example does not build anything on its own.

go_runtime._comment: git archive of the root Go module tree at the pinned commit (excludes cdk-go)

go_cdk._comment: git archive of the cdk-go/apptheorycdk module tree at the pinned commit

npm_cdk._comment: theory-cloud-apptheory-cdk-<version>.tgz; sha256 and npm integrity are both verified

npm_ts_runtime._comment: theory-cloud-apptheory-<version>.tgz; sha256 and npm integrity are both verified
